$comment: Austria's golden cases (migration 0228, ADR-0165 amendment): the 20 questions of the before-baseline (docs/design/international/quality-and-cost.md) and the dev-acceptance scenarios A1 to A8 (docs/design/international/dev-acceptance.md), proposed through records-propose in a change request for AT once the Austria pack is published, reviewed and published like any platform change; never seeded. Each record's note says where its expectation was taken from; the operator captures that source and cites it with a quote before the record can be proposed (KC-6). An expectation with grounding `unconfirmed` was not checked against a text or a record in this repository: a reviewer confirms or rewrites it. Edit the records, not a generator.
